title: SEC0-R2: fit_col panics or truncates incorrectly when max < 2
description:
The fit_col() function in crates/kithctl/src/main.rs (lines 97-105) handles single-character (max=1) column widths incorrectly.

When max=1:
- chars.len() > max evaluates to true for any non-empty input
- chars[..max-1] becomes chars[..0] (empty)
- Result is just ellipsis '…' with no content

Example: fit_col('A', 1) returns '…' instead of 'A'

The function should ensure truncation only when strictly necessary:
if chars.len() > max && max > 1 { ... }

Or add a minimum width check at function entry.

Current usage only passes widths ≥25, so this doesn't manifest in practice, but fit_col is public and could be reused elsewhere.
